title: Trademark license agreement

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Separate design guidance from permission to use an identity, so a designer does not mistake an available logo for unrestricted authorization.
strategic_value: Documented scope and duration can help IBM keep third-party trademark use aligned with the actual relationship.
demonstration: Three text blocks explain licensing, preparation before use and a bold statement that an executed license prevails in a conflict.
practical_value: Check the applicable agreement’s scope before treating any example as permission to use the mark.

content_islands.name: Heading
content_islands.spec: Place Trademark license agreement at upper left.

content_islands.name: License requirements
content_islands.spec: Use two paragraphs in the adjoining column for scope, duration and contacting the IBM sponsor.

content_islands.name: Precedence statement
content_islands.spec: End the column with the bold clarification that executed license terms prevail over inconsistent guidance.

reference_purposes.Application: The page directs users to review the agreement and contact their IBM sponsor when an agreement is absent.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires a license other than fair use and gives executed license terms precedence over inconsistent guideline terms.
